# Hi, I'm Junze.

I'm a master's student in **Biostatistics, Public Health Data Science** at
Columbia University's Mailman School of Public Health. My background is in

complex data into useful answers.

## Technical background

My experience includes developing AI applications at Baidu, working on multimodal
agents at Baiyang Future, and building a retrieval-augmented question answering
system. These projects have involved programming, testing, and evaluating how
models perform on practical tasks.

At Columbia, I'm building on that technical background through coursework in
probability, biostatistical methods, data science, and epidemiology. You can read
more about my education and selected technical experience on my
[resume](resume.html).
